How the Act shares the KSh 428 billion

  • Baseline387.425From each county's FY2024/25 allocation. 90.5% of the money.
  • Weighted formula36.115Population 45%, equal share 35%, poverty 12%, geographical size 8%. 8.4% of the money.
  • Affirmative action4.46012 counties, KSh 371.7 million each. 1.0% of the money.
